Translation: In the Name of Allah, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send Your blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ صِيَامِيْ فِيْهِ صِيَامَ الصَّائِمِيْنَ
Translation: O Allah, make my fasting in this month the fasting of the truly fasting ones
And my standing (in prayer) in it the standing of those who stand (in worship)
And awaken me in it from the slumber of the heedless ones

Arabic text: وَهَبْ لِيْ جُرْمِيْ فِيْهِ يَا إِلٰهَ العَالَمِيْنَ
Translation: And forgive my sins in it, O God of the worlds

Arabic text: وَاعْفُ عَنِّيْ يَا عَافِيًا عَنِ المُجْرِمِيْنَ
Translation: And pardon me, O Pardoner of the sinners
